## About
Ozden Auto Repair is a full service emissions and general repair shop in Richmond, serving drivers around the Bay Area. Smog is our specialty. We run official smog checks, take Test Only directed vehicles as a STAR station, and when a car fails, we find out why and fix it.
We also handle everyday repair work, from brakes and suspension to engines, transmissions, exhaust welding and electrical problems. For trucking companies and owner-operators, we do Clean Truck Check (CARB) inspections on heavy-duty diesel trucks, at the shop or on your lot.
Customers give us a 4.3 rating from 55 Google reviews. Stop by on 23rd Street or give us a call.

## Services
- STAR smog station: Official smog testing, including Test Only directed vehicles.
- Smog failure repairs: If your car failed smog, we find the problem and repair it.
- CAP (Consumer Assistance Program) service: We are a Consumer Assistance Program service location.
- Clean Truck Check (CARB) inspections: Inspections for heavy-duty diesel trucks to stay compliant with California emissions standards, with flexible scheduling for fleets and individual operators.
- Check engine light diagnostic: We track down what is behind a check engine or service engine soon light.
- Engine and transmission work: Engine repair plus engine and transmission replacement.
- Struts, shocks and suspension: Suspension work, including struts and shocks.

## FAQ
Q: Can you test Test Only directed vehicles?
A: Yes. We are a STAR smog station, so Test Only directed vehicles can be tested here.

Q: Do you inspect diesel trucks for fleets?
A: Yes. We do Clean Truck Check (CARB) inspections with flexible scheduling for fleets and individual operators. Call and ask for Ozden to schedule or request a fleet quote.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open 9 AM to 6 PM Monday through Friday, and 9 AM to 5 PM on Saturday.
